|items = * [[Ice gloves]] (obtainable during the quest) or [[Smiths gloves (i)]]

* [[Black platelegs]] (plateskirt or trimmed will not work)

* Some form of [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] attack method

* [[Weapons]] and [[armour]] to kill the [[Ice Queen]]
* [[Stamina potion|Stamina]] or [[energy potion]]s
* [[Anti-dragon shield|Anti-dragon]] or [[dragonfire shield]] to protect against the [[blue dragon]]s' [[dragonfire]] breath

* Fast travel to several locations
** Burthorpe ([[games necklace]] or [[Burthorpe Games Room]] [[Minigame Teleport]])
** Varrock ([[Varrock teleport]], [[Chronicle]], [[ring of wealth]] to the Grand Exchange or [[combat bracelet]] to the Champions' Guild)
** Brimhaven ([[Brimhaven teleport]], [[Teleport to House]] if it is in Brimhaven, [[charter ship]] or ship from Ardougne or Rimmington to Brimhaven or [[amulet of glory]] to Karamja)
